fields.description: Program Description Why Guangwai MBA? • International Program Focus on “Global Vision, English Instruction; Field Immersion, Local Solution” • Chinese Experience and Imprint In-depth knowledge on doing business in China and extensive network with Guangwai MBAs alumni and local business community • Affordable Tuition and Expense “Made-in-China，，tuition and affordable living expense. • Business School of GDUFS has Passed AM BA Accreditation On May 14th, 2015，at the AMBAJs (Association of AM BAs) Global Conference for Deans and Directors in Prague, Czech, Prof. ZHU Wenzhong, Executive Dean of the School of Business, received the AM BA accreditation certificate from Sir Paul Judge, the Chairman of AM BA, which marks that the MBA programme of the School of Business has met the criteria of AM BA and the School becomes No. 26 in China and No. 225 in the world as an AMBA-accredited business school. About Gangdong University of Foreign Studies Gangdong University of Foreign Studies (GDUFS, also known as Guangwai), founded in 1965, is one of the prestigious universities in south China which specializes in international studies and educates professionals for international business and management. It now has over 23,000 full-time students, among whom 3,000 are MA or PhD students. And the number of foreign students is over 2,000. The MBA Education Center, was founded in July 2007. With its commitment to "Global Vision, English Instruction; Field Immersion, Local Solution"，The MBA Education Center of Guangwai is dedicated to developing global managers with knowledge and insight of both east and west. Brief Introduction MBA program curriculum has distinctive international features forming an advanced training program which consists of four modules, namely common course, general education, core course and elective course. And there are four orientations in elective course module, including transitional operation and enterprise internationalization, organizational behavior and enterprise innovation, marketing and financial management. Moreover, other distinctive courses, such as minority languages, health management, forum and business practice, are provided for MBA students. Teaching Objective It is a two-year program for people who have at least two-year work experience by the date of entry. The program( autumn semester ) is a full-time program and adopts the credit system. The program is designed for those who want to hone their International business communication ability as well as learn international management knowledge and skills, after two years of immersive study; you will be quite qualified for senior management positions, can directly participate in international cooperation and competition. Program Length 2 years (full-time), 3 years(part-time), students home and abroad study together Main Courses Core courses & Forums Managerial Economics Human Resource Management Marketing Accounting (Financial Accounting & Managerial Accounting) Organization Behavior Corperations Management Management Information System Strategic Management Executive Forum Yunshan MBA Forum Common courses Chinese Econmy English Listening English Speaking English Writing Concentration of Business Internationalization Foreign-orented Economy in Guangzhou Cross-culture Communication & Management International Business Law International Business Elective Courses Corporate Governance Business Decision Simulation Leadership Development Career Development Business Ethics Cross-culture Consumer Behavior Strategic Brand Management Culture Marketing Internatinal Finance Market Macroeconomics for Professional Management Financial Decision under Uncertainly Internatinal Inverstment Business Path Business Statistics ... click here for MBA courses and credits Degree Awarded Master's Degree of Business Administration Accreditation From September 23th to 24th, 2013, our Dean Sin Xiaoqin attended the AMBA Certification Forum held by Spanish IE Business School in Madrid at the invitation of Association of MBAs. During the Forum, Dean Sun Xiaoqin had a cordial talk with the Director of Master Program of Management, Professor Martin Boehm and the Director of International Relationship, Maria-Eugenia Marin from Spanish IE Business School. They discussed the possible cooperation mode in the future, and reached a preliminary consensus. Compus Life

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A study plan about 1500 words * 2. Non-Criminal Record Certificate The applicant must submit a Non-Criminal Record Certificate issued by the local public security authorities usually within a 6-months’ validity before the date of submission of the application. The Non-Criminal Records Certificate should be with Chinese language translation and official notarization stamp from Chinese Embassy, or with the APOSTILLE verification. The certificate must be submitted to the University in original, scanned version or photocopy is invalid. Before sending the original, please be sure to send an electronic version to confirm with the University whether the content meets the requirement, and confirm the mailing address as well. * 3. English proficiency test certificate A copy of the certificate to prove your English language ability(like GMAT or GRE) is required. * 4. Medical examination report valid within 6 months. 5. Other materials 3 years work experience or more. * 6. The abstract of the undergraduate graduation thesis. * 7. Photocopy of passport main page and Chinese visa page *(if have) * 8. A 1-inch digital bareheaded colorized photo * 9. Certificate/diploma of Bachelor degree Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 10. Academic transcript of Bachelor degree Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 11. Copies of two recommendation letters from your referees The title of your referees should be associate professor or above. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements To be eligible, an applicant must: (1) Be non-Chinese nationality, hold a foreign passport and meet the relevant requirements of the Regulation No.〔2020〕12 by Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. (2) Stay in good health both mentally and physically, and meet the physical examination standards for the study visa or residence permit in China required by the Chinese government. (3) Abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the University rules and regulations; be diligent and well-performed in academics and good conduct; no violation of the University rules and disciplines, no public security punishment, no criminal record. (4) Applicants for MBA are not required to provide Chinese proficiency certificate, but are required to provide scanned copies of GMAT, GRE, TOEFL, IELTS or other relevant proficiency certificates, and are required to have work experience. TOEFL 70 or IELTS 5.5 above is required for applicants applying for English-taught program from non-English-speaking countries, or pass the entrance exam and interview organized by the IIE. (5) Under the age of 35 for the postgraduate programs. (6) Abide by requirements of other relevant laws and regulations.
